runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target writes an observed store image over an opaque shape and never reads a vtable
0x005b0f80 is a dependency-only port, so the base class field overlay is unverified in this package
the 0x01485720 scale word is read raw and its runtime value is unverified
the 0x013ec458 write is immediately overwritten and is therefore dead, which the model reproduces rather than eliding
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation elides the 0x013ec458 write at +0x14 because the 0x013f7214 write follows it; the corrected model keeps both so the store image matches the assembly
the decompilation reads 0x01485720 as a dword into a wider value; the assembly uses MOVSS, so the model copies exactly four bytes

The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
